content.text:
[b]Welcome to the course.[/b]

This tab is your home base. Every lesson has the same shape:
1. [b]Watch[/b] the video (opens in your browser; comes back marked done).
2. [b]Answer[/b] the check questions.
3. [b]Build[/b] in the editor — the live checks below turn green AS you work.
4. [b]Run test cases[/b] when you code — failures come with hints, not judgment.
5. [b]Write[/b] your response when asked — a human (your teacher) reads those.

The progress bar at the top is the whole truth: 100% = lesson done.

One rule to remember forever: [b]save your file before running tests[/b]. The grader reads what's on disk, not what's on your screen.

Enter your student ID above (your teacher gave it to you — it's yours all year), then answer the two questions below. Watch what happens to the progress bar.

assessments.title: Check: finding your way
assessments.question: Where do you see how much of a lesson you've completed?
choices: The progress bar at the top of the Classroom tab

assessments.title: Check: the one rule
assessments.question: Your code looks perfect but the test cases fail. What's the FIRST thing to try?
choices: Save the file, then run the tests again
